description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Escrow a1 has a finalized open and a finalized release, neither with a block_number key. Census clause 7 makes an event with no block_number key malformed, and the escrow rules read events the same way, so both are ignored with a note and a1 is unverified, not claimed. Escrow b2 has a finalized open whose block_number is an explicit null: it is kept, so b2 is funded, and the result notes that the finalized height cannot bound that evidence.
